name: Decide whether the house has a closed day and where the reviews sit
text_content:
Type: founder decision

The record is silent on a closed day. The leads' review and the house review are placed at closed hours; if a closed day exists both sit on it. The partners close this (P23).

Filed by Session 4 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhjr. Reasoning lives on the S4 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
